event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Seventy-eight. Quick, for you. Nothing in Wetherell needs you this hour. Sit. I'll count again, slower.
event.odalys_heart2.1.why: frightened band; a Keeper's gentleness, slower care

event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Sixty-eight. A touch quick. The morning fog, perhaps. It unsettles everyone's numbers, every year, right on schedule.
event.odalys_heart2.1.why: uneasy full; 'on schedule' is the exactness tell

event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Sixty-eight. A touch quick. Mornings like this do it. I'll note the weather beside the number.

event.odalys_heart2.4.text: Half of Wetherell eats standing up. I keep a list. I keep several. You have just been crossed off one.
event.odalys_heart2.4.why: hint: she keeps more lists than one; joke intact

event.odalys_heart5.3.text: Edmund's page is here. He set everything in order because he chose to. I was there; I held the lamp. ...Tidy, at the end.
event.odalys_heart5.3.why: revelation slip, protective and hurt, never confessed outright

event.odalys_heart5.3.text: Edmund has a page. That last fall he followed every instruction, settled every account, said his goodbyes properly. As if he knew the date. ...Tidy, at the end.
event.odalys_heart5.3.why: clue: Edmund chosen, echoing not repeating 'affairs in order'

event.odalys_heart5.2.text: Use it well. Eat, sleep, keep your lamp filled. And come show me your margins. Often. I like knowing you're well.
event.odalys_heart5.2.why: frightened band; care turns too exact, lamp motif

dlg.story.pie.talk.r2b.text: An empty plate and a crumb on your sleeve. Good — you ate today. I'll bill Marcus for the pie. The crumb is forgiven.
dlg.story.pie.talk.r2b.why: dread makes her gentler; billing joke kept, crumb pardoned

event.odalys_heart8.intro.text: Sit. The clinic is closed; I closed it for you as much as me. You've had a hard stretch — I can see it. Tonight: soup, company, and nothing asked of you.
event.odalys_heart8.intro.why: frightened band; the scene becomes shelter

dlg.odalys.office.0.text: I prescribe rest to everyone. I don't take it; I can't afford to. I know what my hours cost me. I know, and I choose them. Tonight I'm choosing this instead.
dlg.odalys.office.0.why: her sheet tell, 'I know, I choose,' slipped and covered

dlg.odalys.office.0.text: I prescribe rest to everyone. I keep none for myself; some work doesn't wait, and mine keeps its own calendar. This is unfamiliar. Be gentle.
dlg.odalys.office.0.why: clue: a duty with its own dates, mild-safe

dlg.odalys.office.r1.text: Two spoons, one pot. The world can wait at the door tonight; nothing out there outranks supper. You diagnosed me in one visit.
dlg.odalys.office.r1.why: frightened band; she holds the door against the night, gently

event.odalys_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday. I observe it annually, with soup, tonight only; tomorrow is spoken for. Consider this an invitation, not an order.
event.odalys_birthday.intro.why: hint: Winter 3 sits the night before a day-4 night

dlg.odalys.birthday.0.text: You stayed. Good. Tonight of all nights, I'd rather not sit with the soup alone. What now?
dlg.odalys.birthday.0.why: frightened band; double meaning stays warm, prompt kept

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4.text: Good care. Wake me for emergencies only. And wake me at dusk regardless. I'll want the light.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4.why: uneasy: too-exact instruction about dusk, one gate serves both levels

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l1.text: Ione. Your lamps burned an hour past closing on Thursday. Some nights the village should be dark. I keep records.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l1.why: hint: an odd rule stated as housekeeping

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.text: A tea that calms a stove. I'll want the leaf's name. Lately everything could stand to be calmer.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.why: uneasy: small admission the air is wrong, warmth intact

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l2.text: I don't sit on that bench. It faces the wood. I prefer the window; better light.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l2.why: uneasy: a Keeper's seating preference, mood-readable alone

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_3.l3.text: I did say that. You listened. You always have, Marcus, on harder instructions than rest.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_3.l3.why: clue: two Keepers, a shared duty under a compliment

adds.text: One more thing. If you can't sleep some night, the clinic lamp is on. Knock. I'm usually awake.
adds.why: the thing a Keeper does not quite say; she is always awake
pure beat; the silence after 'Tidy, at the end' lands it
